description: An animal shelter lists pets and handles applications to adopt them.
data: pets with a name, a species and whether the pet has been adopted
applications to adopt a pet with the applicant's name and a status (pending, approved or rejected)
actions: people apply to adopt a pet
staff approve or reject an application
rules: nobody can apply for a pet that is already adopted
approving an application marks the pet as adopted and rejects the other applications for that pet
an application can only be decided once
